text: May all wounds gently heal in time, and may tomorrow bring a sincere, warm smile.
To whoever is fighting quietly on their own tonight: you are doing wonderful, please don't give up.
Hoping that distance will never fade the warmth between two hearts.
May this final thesis and design journey be completed with joy and pride for mom and dad.
May my grandmother find eternal peace, watching over us like this warm golden lantern.
Grateful for having the strength to keep holding on and walking this far.
I wish to find the courage to say the words I've kept hidden in my heart for three years.
May our little family always stay healthy, close, and blessed with simple happiness.
May peace gently touch the quietest and most tired corners of this world.
I hope one day our paths cross again, when both our hearts have found forgiveness.
May the quiet dreams written in my little notebook slowly blossom into reality.
To the stranger who feels completely lost: take a deep breath. The stars are listening.
Hoping my little sister gets well soon and runs joyfully once more under the morning sun.
I wish I could hug you one last time.
